Usage: yantra browser update [options]

Replace the Yantra-managed browser with current Chrome for Testing Stable. This
is the only command that checks whether a newer browser exists; use --dry-run to
report availability and download nothing

Options:
  --dry-run   report what is available without downloading or changing anything
              (default: false)
  --yes       accept the replacement without prompting (default: false)
  --json      emit exactly one JSON outcome (default: false)
  -h, --help  display help for command
